__key_facts: names[] is COMPLETE and length === skillCount. Parse names[], not content.

content is a rendered listing held to a 30000-char budget. It is NOT row-truncated: it has exactly one row per skill (rows === skillCount, 0 unmatched in all sessions checked). What the budget drops is DESCRIPTIONS - in this record only 61 of 581 rows keep a description; the other 520 render as a bare '- name'.

CONSEQUENCE FOR THE COST MODEL: the always-on context cost of the skill listing is hard-capped at ~30000 chars (~7.5k tokens) regardless of roster size. Above the cap the marginal always-on cost of one more skill is its name plus 3 chars, NOT its description. Per-entity always-on cost is therefore NOT additive above the cap. See FINDINGS error mode 6.
The cap applies to skill_listing only - agent_listing_delta.addedLines carries all 80 full descriptions uncapped, and deferred_tools_delta shows no cap.
names[] mixes personal skills (bare), plugin skills (<plugin>:<skill>), user slash commands (<dir>:<name>) and built-in skills (bare). Bare does NOT mean personal.
